_comment: Cells are 32x40 (tools/art/kaya40.py), feet on row 39 centred on column 16, so the unchanged 10x22 hitbox sits at ox 11, oy 18. Frames 39-45 are the stoop drawn under a ceiling lower than the sprite, 46-49 the swim, and 50-58 the slung-hat narrow set drawn where the space is narrower than the frame (a one-tile shaft is 16 px, the brim 21), 58 being its crouch for a space both low and narrow; src/player/kaya_pose.gd chooses them, render-only, using `pose` below, and tools/clipgate.sh proves the choice against every proof tape. Frames 20-30 are Phase A, docs/plan-art-motion.md: turn, skid, push, throw, catch, fidget. The 'turn' strip's timing is NOT driven by its fps/loop below — RenderFacingFSM in src/player/render_facing_fsm.gd paces it instead, guarded against coyote_time by tests/test_render_facing_fsm.gd. Frames 31-38 are Phase F: the idle dance, 8 original frames played twice through (player.gd repeats the list) at 8fps.
